Each shelf is organized by color and brand, showing a vast array of textures from fuzzy wool to smooth cotton. Price tags and Japanese labels are attached to every shelf edge. A hand gently presses into the soft, pastel-colored yarn. The environment remains a bright, clean retail space with white shelving units. Further pans show different sections of the store, including large spools of yarn on lower shelves and neatly stacked materials. (8) The main woman appears again, playfully covering her face with her hands as if overwhelmed by the choices. She is standing in front of a wall of colorful conical yarn spools labeled 'ITORICOT'. (9) The video concludes with a shot of the shopping basket resting on a white floor, filled with six vibrant balls of yarn as the final selection.
